zh.summary: 完善离线更新文件准备、桌面交互与更新恢复。
highlights: 离线文件：在更新页选择保存目录，自动下载并校验同版清单、签名和对应 ZIP，无需手动配齐；支持取消，并明确提示缺失或不匹配的文件。
窗口：高 DPI 下菜单、导航图标和窗口按钮按实际布局缩放；最大化窗口关闭到托盘后保持隐藏，恢复时减少不必要的窗口重建。
更新：相同的在途检查共用一次查询；查询不再准备内核或新建运行租约，损坏缓存可重新获取，网络失败明确显示不可用。 版本下载页同时提供完整包清单的原始签名。
恢复：整包升级中断后可继续处理恢复记录；仅安装不启动时保留待验证状态，启动验收通过后才提交更新。
插件：修复 rc.3 官方页面缺少更新入口的问题；更新检查接受与启动一致的合法 YAML 配置，保留错误配置拒绝及并发写入保护。 默认采用更新至已发布的 Image Viewer 0.1.17、Chat Manager 1.5.19，默认内核保持 0.2.1-rc.3。
诊断与性能：收紧日志路径和目录打开操作，改善并发日志写入；大文件校验使用流式读取，减少额外内存。
upgradeNotes: 正常退出应用后更新，并备份重要数据；升级保留会话、设置、凭据、插件和工作区。
0.9.6 及更早版本请使用新版 Windows 引导器。离线升级须配齐同一版本的原始清单 JSON、签名和 ZIP，操作见 [离线更新指南](https://github.com/WSL043/DSH-Portable/blob/main/docs/offline-updates.md)。
acknowledgements: 感谢 [@ArtificialAngels](https://github.com/ArtificialAngels) 在 [#214](https://github.com/WSL043/DSH-Portable/pull/214) 提供插件 YAML 更新预检修复。
感谢 [@ArtificialAngels](https://github.com/ArtificialAngels) 在 [#227](https://github.com/WSL043/DSH-Portable/pull/227) 提供最大化窗口关闭到托盘的修复。

en.summary: Improves offline update preparation, desktop interactions and update recovery.
highlights: Offline files: choose a destination in update settings to download and verify the matching manifest, signature and ZIP together, with cancellation and specific missing-file or mismatch messages.

Windows: scales menus, navigation icons and window controls with the effective layout at high DPI; maximized windows stay hidden when closed to the tray, with fewer unnecessary window-handle recreations on restore.

Update checks: share identical in-flight requests without preparing the core or acquiring runtime leases; recover damaged caches and report network failures explicitly. Version downloads also include the original full-package manifest signature.
Recovery: resume interrupted full-upgrade records; installation without launching remains pending verification until startup acceptance commits the update.

Plugins: restores update controls on the rc.3 official page; update preflight accepts the same valid YAML dialect as startup while rejecting invalid configuration and concurrent writers. Defaults adopt the published Image Viewer 0.1.17 and Chat Manager 1.5.19; the default core remains 0.2.1-rc.3.
Diagnostics and performance: guards log paths and folder opening, improves concurrent log writes and streams large-file verification to reduce additional memory use.
upgradeNotes: Exit normally and back up important data before upgrading. Sessions, settings, credentials, plugins and workspaces are preserved.

From 0.9.6 or earlier, use the new Windows bootstrap. For offline upgrades, keep the original manifest JSON, signature and ZIP from the same version together; see the [offline update guide](https://github.com/WSL043/DSH-Portable/blob/main/docs/offline-updates.md).
acknowledgements: Thanks to [@ArtificialAngels](https://github.com/ArtificialAngels) for the plugin YAML preflight fix in [#214](https://github.com/WSL043/DSH-Portable/pull/214).
Thanks to [@ArtificialAngels](https://github.com/ArtificialAngels) for the maximized-window tray-close fix in [#227](https://github.com/WSL043/DSH-Portable/pull/227).
